 How to Watch Timberwolves vs Magic
 When: Friday, October 23, 2026
 Time: 7:00 PM ET
 TV Channel: DAZN MIN
 Live Stream: DAZN ( watch now )
 Minnesota opened the 2026-27 NBA season with a statement victory, defeating the Miami Heat 131-106 behind an incredible performance from Anthony Edwards. The superstar guard scored 45 points while knocking down nine 3-pointers, setting the tone for a Timberwolves team with championship aspirations. Newcomer LaMelo Ball also impressed in his Minnesota debut, contributing 21 points and six assists. With Edwards and Ball forming one of the most exciting backcourts in basketball, the Timberwolves will look to improve to 2-0 and continue building chemistry with their revamped roster.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Orlando enters Friday searching for its first victory after falling 132-125 to the Atlanta Hawks in its season opener. Paolo Banchero delivered an outstanding performance with 35 points, 10 assists, and seven rebounds, while Franz Wagner and Wendell Carter Jr. added 22 points apiece. Despite the offensive production, the Magic struggled defensively and committed 20 turnovers, ultimately costing them the game. With Banchero and Wagner leading a talented young core, Orlando will look to bounce back against a Minnesota team that appears ready to compete among the Western Conference's best.
